To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Mex67/Mtr2 heterodimer binds to all repeat types of nucleoporin found in the nuclear pore complex and interacts genetically with several repeat nucleoporin proteins, suggesting a direct role in the export process.
the Mex67/Mtr2p nuclear mRNA export heterodimer interacts with several repeat nucleoporin-containing subcomplexes of the nuclear pore complex.
the Mex67/Mtr2 heterodimer binds to all types of nucleoporins (FXFG, GLFG, and FG), and that the Mex67 and Mtr2 genes genetically interact with different repeat nucleoporins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of the molecular machinery involved in the export of mRNAs and proteins from the nucleus.
the molecular mechanism of mRNA export.
elucidating how mRNAs are exported from the nucleus of eukaryotic cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
nuclear mRNA export requires direct interaction of Mex67p with several nucleoporins, and that the Mex67/Mtr2 complex is essential for mRNA export.
Mex67p/MTR2 is an essential component of the mRNA export pathway and that the Mex67/Mtr2p dimer is required for the interaction of mRNA export factors with nucleoporins.
nuclear mRNA export requires Mex67p/MTR2 to directly contact several nucleoporin subcomplexes of the NPC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Mex67p/Mrt2p binds to all three repeat types of nucleoporins, and that this binding is essential for mRNA export.
the Mex67/Mtr2p mRNA export complex interacts with the nuclear basket and the cytoplasmic filaments of the nuclear pore.
the Mex67/Mtr2 heterodimeric protein is the main factor responsible for the nuclear mRNA export.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Mex67p and the Mex67p-Mtr2p hetero-dimer interact with different repeat nucleoporins and that these interactions are required for mRNA export.
the Mex67/Mtr2 complex interacts with several different types of nucleoporins, and these interactions are required for mRNA export.
the Mex67/Mtr2 heterodimer binds to the different types of repeat domains in NUPs, and that this binding is essential for mRNA export.
